The '''Filordis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Larrin sector/Legends|Larrin sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Filordis/Legends|Filordis]].
